zh.place: 布鲁克林 Adrian的旧公寓

zh: 廉价咖啡机又卡住了。洗衣机甩干时一下下撞墙，水龙头关不严，昨晚的外卖盒还搁在水槽边。
手机亮着两条通知：活期账户 $32.18。房租周五到期。
Adrian一边套上皱衬衫一边接老板电话。“客户改方向了。”他闭了闭眼。
昨天，我账户里只有32美元。
十年前。便利店门口，十七岁的Adrian低着头，给十八岁的Roman破了的嘴角贴创可贴。
两人同时抬眼，近得过分。Roman的拇指碰了一下他耳后。差半寸。
没有吻上。十年前，我最好的朋友差一点亲了我。
第二天早上，他就消失了。消息没人回，便利店门口空着。
关于父亲，母亲留下的永远只有一句：很复杂。Adrian挤进早高峰的地铁。
我以为我的人生大概就这样了。
一声急刹。三辆黑色SUV停在旧公寓楼下。
Roman从第二辆车后走出来。黑西装，耳后通讯器。十年没见。

zh.t: THE HEIR HE CAME BACK FOR

zh: Adrian穿着昂贵的白衬衫，双手被绑在椅背后。三天前那件皱衬衫，已经像别人的人生。
地上的手机在倒计时：VALE继承投票 00:08:42。
绑匪：“你们Vale家还有八分钟。”Adrian抬起擦伤的脸：“那他们用不了八分钟。”
刀刃割开绳索。第二声枪响，Roman手臂横过Adrian腰侧，把他整个人拽进货架后面。
战术背心的金属扣很冷，他的体温却热得清楚。十年前，他也是这样把我拉到身后。
Adrian扣住他的后颈，吻了上去。Roman第一秒没动，第二秒掌心扣住他腰侧，把最后一点距离拉没。
短、重，像压了十年的东西失控了一秒。然后他强行停住，额头抵着Adrian。
“已经晚十年了。”Adrian的手碰到Roman腹侧一片湿热。低头——是血。
外面，第二辆车急刹。画面冻结。

zh.sub: 这个选择，72小时后归还给你。

zh.place: 布鲁克林 公寓楼下

zh: 老板最后一条消息还停在屏幕上：中午前改完。Adrian推开那扇总卡住的玻璃门。
街上的光被三辆黑色SUV切断。平时停满外卖电动车的位置，清得干干净净。
第二辆车门打开。Roman看人之前先扫一圈四周，紧张时下颌收紧——这些Adrian全认得。
认得太快，这才让人恼火。脑子还需要一秒，身体完全不需要。
十七岁的Roman肩背还没长开。现在黑西装是被肩线撑出形状的，锁骨下一道旧疤，腕骨上也有。
Adrian有十年的问题要问，视线却先往下停了一秒。

zh.hint: 他抓到你在看他。十年没见，第一回合。

opts.t: 完全没有。
then: Roman的眼神停了半秒，喉结滚了一下。随即恢复，像什么都没发生。

opts.t: Adrian移开视线，假装在看车牌。
then: Roman没拆穿。嘴角很短地动了一下。

opts.t: 你先说。你看够了吗？
then: 话一出口，他自己的下颌先绷紧了。

zh.hint: 他还在看你。十年了，你还是不知道该先说哪句。

opts.t: 上车。
我知道你有很多问题。先上车。
then: 话说得很稳，手却在车门上收紧了。

opts.t: Roman伸手想碰他手臂，停在半空，又收回。“上车，Adrian。”
then: 那只停在半空的手，Adrian看见了。

zh: “你消失十年，第一句话就这个？”
Adrian走到他面前：“你有整整十年。”

zh.hint: 这句话你在车里练了四十分钟。没有一种说法是对的。

opts.t: 你父亲昨天去世了。
Adrian，先听我说完。……你父亲昨天去世了。
then: 他说得很慢，眼睛一直没离开Adrian的脸。

opts.t: Roman没开口，把平板递过去。讣告停在屏幕上。
then: Adrian看清了标题：ALEXANDER VALE，昨日辞世。

zh: Adrian脸上的讽刺第一次消失了。“我没有父亲。”

zh.title: 你父亲是Alexander Vale
zh.txt: 酒店、银行、航空、媒体——就是那个Vale。

zh: 车门合上。旧公寓、便利店、公交站牌，被隔音玻璃一点点甩到身后。
Roman从前排接过一只黑色文件夹，放到Adrian腿上。
第一页：ALEXANDER VALE，已故。第二页：亲子关系确认。第三页：ADRIAN HALE，匹配度99.998%。
他没翻资产页，先把DNA结果来回看了两遍。这个数字精确到没法拿“弄错了”安慰自己。
有些人生变化伴着巨响。他的，发生在一辆安静得过分的车里，印在一张昂贵的纸上。
“他昨天刚死。所以今天我突然成他儿子了？”
Roman给了他几秒，才划开平板：VALE集团——控股受益继承人。
多到具体数字已经没什么帮助。控股权、私人航空、酒店、媒体、地产、银行。
今天，连存你那32美元的银行都有你的股份。

zh.hint: 那串还没看清的数字，就摊在你腿上。你的第一反应是——

opts.t: 把完整资产清单给我。别给摘要。
then: “没有，我还在震惊。”Adrian把平板转回来，“我只是比较喜欢拿着资料震惊。”
Roman嘴角很轻地动了一下。屏幕上依次展开：黑卡、曼哈顿顶层、私人航空、董事会临时投票权。

opts.t: 我母亲知道吗？
then: Roman的表情第一次真正变得谨慎。
这是我现在能给你的答案。
“她一辈子都在算账单。”Adrian的手指压住那页资产，“而他有这些？”
你母亲做过一些选择，就是为了让你远离这个家族。

then.title: 线索：母亲知道得更多
then.txt: 那笔钱有整整三秒，不再像奖励。

opts.t: Adrian直接把资产页按灭。
then: “我更想知道，为什么偏偏是你来告诉我。你知道多久了？”
三年。这两个字比那串数字更快击中他。钱能解释那些车，解释不了他看了三年却一次都没走近。

opts.t: 停车。我要自己确认。
then: 今早6点14分，有人侵入了你住处的监控。
他把自己的加密手机推过来。
DNA你可以查，我可以查，律师也可以查。但不能停在这儿查。
实验室回执、Vale官方讣告、Roman的安保授权、律所登记。Adrian一个个查过去。全是真的。

zh: Roman在平板右上角轻点一下。那一页数字缩了下去，换成四格黑白监控。
继承说明书里不会写的那部分。今早6点14分，有人进了你楼里的监控系统。
大概率。另一种可能更糟。
这是第一次，这笔继承不再只是荒唐，而是危险。

zh.hint: Roman把平板转过来：“你在那栋楼住了三年。哪里不对，你比我清楚。”
zh.title: 监控画面 · 6:14
zh.hint2: 拖动时间轴。四段录像里有一个人不对劲——点他。

cams.clue: 楼梯间只是三楼的老太太下楼取报纸。
电梯里的外卖员正脸对着镜头打哈欠。
后门男子从头到尾没露过正脸，却准确踩着每一个摄像头死角。
大厅保安在打瞌睡，一切照旧。

win: Adrian点中后门的那一刻，Roman侧过脸看了他一眼。
lose: Roman伸手放大后门画面：那人始终背对镜头，每一步都踩在死角上。
skip: 后门那个人，知道每一个死角。所以我亲自来了。

t: 后门那个死角，三年前我就报过修。没人修。今天有人用上了。

en: The cheap coffee maker jams again. The washer bangs the wall on spin, the faucet drips, last night's takeout is still by the sink.
Two notifications on his phone: CHECKING — $32.18. RENT DUE FRIDAY.
Adrian pulls on a wrinkled shirt with the phone at his ear. "Client changed direction." He closes his eyes.
Yesterday, I had thirty-two dollars in checking.
Ten years ago. Outside a convenience store, seventeen-year-old Adrian presses a bandage over the split in eighteen-year-old Roman's lip.
They look up at the same time. Too close. Roman's thumb brushes the spot behind his ear. Half an inch.
It never lands. Ten years ago, my best friend almost kissed me.
The next morning, he was gone. Texts unanswered. The curb outside the store, empty.
About his father, his mother only ever said one thing: It's complicated. Adrian squeezes onto the rush-hour train.
I thought that was my life.
Brakes shriek. Three black SUVs pull up outside the old building.
Roman steps out from behind the second car. Black suit, earpiece. Ten years.

en.t: THE HEIR HE CAME BACK FOR

en: Adrian sits in an expensive white shirt, wrists tied behind the chair. The wrinkled shirt from three days ago belongs to someone else's life.
A phone on the floor counts down: VALE SUCCESSION VOTE — 00:08:42.
The kidnapper: "Your family has eight minutes." Adrian lifts his bruised face. "Then they'll need less."
A blade through the rope. Second shot. Roman's arm hooks across Adrian's waist and hauls him behind the shelving.
The buckles on his vest are cold. The heat of him isn't. Ten years ago, he pulled me behind him exactly like this.
Adrian grabs the back of his neck and kisses him. One second, Roman doesn't move. The next, his hand locks on Adrian's waist and the last inch is gone.
Short. Hard. Ten years of something slipping for one second. Then he stops himself, forehead against Adrian's.
"Ten years late." Adrian's hand finds something wet and warm at Roman's side. He looks down. Blood.
Roman is staring at the gunman on the floor.
Outside, a second car brakes hard. Freeze.

en.sub: This choice comes back to you in 72 hours.

en: His boss's last text is still on screen: Need revision before noon. Adrian shoulders the glass door that always sticks.
Three black SUVs cut off the light. The curb that's usually packed with delivery bikes has been cleared.
The second door opens. Roman checks the street before he looks at anyone; his jaw tightens when he's tense. Adrian knows all of it.
He recognizes him too fast, and that's what makes him mad. His brain needed a second. The rest of him didn't.
At eighteen Roman hadn't filled out. Now the suit takes its shape from his shoulders. A pale scar under the collarbone; more across his wrist.
Adrian has ten years of questions. His eyes drop anyway, for one second.

en.hint: He caught you looking. Ten years, and this is round one.

opts.t: Not remotely.
then: Roman's eyes hold for half a second. His throat moves. Then nothing, like it never happened.

opts.t: Adrian looks away and pretends to read a license plate.
then: Roman doesn't call it. The corner of his mouth moves, barely.

opts.t: You first. Are you done?
then: His own jaw tightens the second it's out.

en.hint: He's still looking at you. Ten years, and you still don't know which sentence goes first.

opts.t: Get in.
I know you've got questions. Get in first.
then: His voice is steady. His hand tightens on the door.

opts.t: Roman reaches for his arm, stops halfway, pulls back. "Get in, Adrian."

en: "You disappear for ten years and that's your first sentence?"
Adrian walks right up to him. "You had ten years."
He opens the back door himself.

en.hint: You rehearsed this for forty minutes in the car. There's no right way to say it.

opts.t: Your father died yesterday.
Adrian, let me finish. ...Your father died yesterday.
then: He says it slowly, and never takes his eyes off Adrian's face.

opts.t: Roman doesn't say it. He hands over the tablet, the obituary on screen.
then: Adrian reads the headline: ALEXANDER VALE DIES AT 61.

en: For the first time, the sarcasm leaves Adrian's face. "I don't have a father."
You do. His name was Alexander Vale.

en.title: Your Father Was Alexander Vale
en.txt: Hotels, banks, airlines, media. That Vale.

en: The door closes. The building, the store, the bus stop slide away behind soundproof glass.
Roman takes a black folder from the front seat and sets it on Adrian's knees.
Page one: ALEXANDER VALE — DECEASED. Page two: PATERNITY CONFIRMATION. Page three: ADRIAN HALE / 99.998% MATCH.
He skips the assets and reads the DNA result twice. The number is too precise to hide behind 'there's been a mistake.'
Some lives change loudly. His changed on expensive paper in a car that was far too quiet.
"He died yesterday. And today I'm suddenly his son?"
You were his son yesterday too.
Roman gives him a few seconds before he unlocks the tablet: VALE GROUP — CONTROLLING BENEFICIAL HEIR.
Enough that the number stops helping. Controlling interests. Private aviation. Hotels. Media. Real estate. Banking.
Today you own shares in the bank holding it.

en.hint: A number you haven't even read yet is sitting on your knees. Your first move is—

opts.t: Give me the complete list. No summaries.
then: "No. I'm still in shock." Adrian turns the tablet back. "I just prefer being shocked with information."
Roman's mouth twitches. The screen unfolds: Black Card. Manhattan penthouse. Private aviation. Temporary board vote.

opts.t: Did my mother know?
then: For the first time, Roman looks careful.
It's the answer I can give you right now.
"She spent her whole life counting bills." Adrian's finger presses the asset page. "And he had this?"
Your mother made choices to keep you away from this family.

then.title: Clue: She Knew More
then.txt: For three whole seconds, the money stops feeling like a prize.

opts.t: Adrian switches the asset page off.
then: You don't want to see it?
"I want to know why you're the one showing it to me. How long?"
Three years. It hits harder than any number on that page. Money explains the cars. It doesn't explain three years of watching and never once walking over.

opts.t: Stop the car. I'm verifying this myself.
then: Someone accessed your building cameras at 6:14 this morning.
He slides his encrypted phone across.
Verify the DNA. Verify me. Verify the lawyers. But do it while moving.
Lab receipt. The official Vale obituary. Roman's security clearance. The law-firm filing. Adrian checks every one. All real.

en: Roman taps the corner of the tablet. The page of numbers shrinks away. Four black-and-white feeds take its place.
The part nobody puts in the inheritance brochure. Someone got into your building's cameras at 6:14.
Most likely. The other possibility is worse.
This is the moment the inheritance stops being absurd and starts being dangerous.

en.hint: Roman turns the tablet toward you. "You've lived in that building three years. You'll see what's wrong faster than I will."
en.title: Security feed · 6:14
en.hint2: Drag the timeline. One person in these four feeds is wrong — tap him.

cams.clue: The stairwell is just Mrs. Ortiz from 3B getting her paper.
The delivery guy in the elevator yawns straight into the lens.
The man at the back door never shows his face once — and he knows every blind spot.
The lobby guard is dozing. Business as usual.

win: When Adrian taps the back door, Roman turns his head and looks at him.

win.title: Clue Card: Inside Knowledge
win.txt: Whoever this is knows Vale's security system.

lose: Roman enlarges the back door feed: the man never faces the camera, and every step lands in a blind spot.

lose.title: Clue Card: Inside Knowledge
lose.txt: Whoever this is knows Vale's security system.

skip: The man at the back door knew every blind spot. That's why I came myself.

en.why: The man on the feed knows Vale security

t: I flagged that blind spot three years ago. Nobody fixed it. Today somebody used it.
